title: Minimal Generalist lineage declaration
description: Declare the committing hotkey and parents, or set from_scratch to true. The external commitment or signed check request identifies the entry and revision.

hotkey.description: ss58 address of the committing hotkey (RULES-v2 3.1)

entry.description: Optional legacy metadata. The external commitment or check request pins the repo and revision.

from_scratch.description: true means no parent. Otherwise declare at least one parent.

parents.description: 1 to 4 parents (the count limit is enforced by the check: REFUSED parents_rule). kind list = a model marked start on the list; entry = an earlier entry of this round (its uid); own = your own earlier entry or public model, with ITS parents in `parents` so the check can verify that its weights come only from allowed parents

own_models.description: Optional legacy description of your own models.

averaged_own_checkpoints.description: Optional note about averaging your own checkpoints.

architecture_changes.description: Optional measurement hints, such as a layer map or quantisation-aware training.

teachers.description: Optional legacy training notes. No teacher approval or declaration is required.

datasets.description: Optional legacy training notes. No per-dataset licence form is required.

mentioned_not_used.description: Optional notes about model IDs mentioned in other files.

licence.description: Optional legacy metadata. Model release still follows rule 2.6.

signature.description: sr25519 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, UTF-8, no whitespace, without this field); required for a correction

training_note.description: Optional one-line note on what you trained on.

share.description: approximate share of this parent in your weights; at least 0.10 each, all add up to 1 +/- 0.02 (checked by the check, see the schema description)

parents.description: kind own only: the parents of your own model (repo@revision each), so that the check can verify that its weights come only from allowed parents
